The structure of Hf2Tl2Ni2 (reduced formula HfTlNi) is orthorhombic, space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a 6-atom unit cell and 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Hf centers coordinated by 10 neighbors (4 Ni, 6 Tl), Ni centers by 9 neighbors (4 Hf, 2 Ni, 3 Tl), and Tl centers by 11 neighbors (1 Hf, 3 Ni, 7 Tl). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 6 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ni 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Hf 10-vertex and Ni 9-vertex polyhedra.
